title: Day 69: Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya Takes 'Temporary Leave' — Unprecedented CJNG-Adjacent Political Fallout as U.S. DOJ Charges Stand
detail: Day 69 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). ROCHA MOYA TEMPORARY LEAVE — MAY 2, 2026: Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya (76) announced a 'temporary leave' from the governorship on May 2, 2026, stepping aside to 'defend himself' against U.S. SDNY charges. Rocha Moya denied all charges as 'baseless' and 'political' in a statement published May 2. The mayor of a Sinaloa municipality also stepped down in connection with the same indictment. This marks the first time a sitting Mexican governor has stepped down in response to U.S. federal drug trafficking charges — an unprecedented moment in U.S.-Mexico bilateral relations. The SDNY indictment (unsealed April 30, 2026) alleged Rocha Moya and nine current and former officials received monthly bribes of $11,000–$41,000 from the Chapitos faction and that cartel members helped secure his 2021 election through kidnappings of opposition candidates, threats, and ballot theft. CJNG CONTEXT: The Chapitos faction (Sinaloa Cartel), whose political allies in Sinaloa are now departing, had reportedly formed a 2025 tactical alliance with CJNG's El Jardinero faction (per InSight Crime, April 29). El Jardinero himself was arrested April 27 — the same week the Chapitos lost their primary political ally in Sinaloa. This double blow to the Chapitos-aligned CJNG faction is reshaping the cross-cartel alignment framework. MEXICO'S OFFICIAL POSITION: President Sheinbaum continued to defend national sovereignty — maintaining that any legal proceedings against Mexican officials should occur within Mexico's justice system, not in U.S. federal courts. She did not endorse or condemn Rocha Moya's temporary leave decision. BILATERAL IMPLICATIONS: CNN, Al Jazeera, and PBS covered the Rocha Moya departure as a landmark event in U.S.-Mexico relations — the first direct political consequence of the DOJ's aggressive unilateral indictment strategy. The same DOJ strategy that pursued Rocha Moya operates in parallel with the sustained CJNG interdiction architecture that produced El Mencho's killing. 40 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Mexico City).

media.caption: Al Jazeera: Mexico's Sinaloa state governor steps down amid U.S. drug trafficking charges — Rubén Rocha Moya takes 'temporary leave' May 2, 2026 after SDNY indictment linking him to Chapitos faction
